_comment: The invulnerability GRANT (plan-effect-types.md C3 / D5): spend a long cooldown to make the ally who needs it most untouchable for five seconds. Structurally it is not a bespoke immunity mechanic at all - it is the first content on the new generic `instant_resist` type (the resist row's cooldown cell, the instant_shield twin), authoring the reserved wildcard tag `*` at factor 0. `*` covers every damage tag the hit carries, factor 0 multiplies it away, and the existing resistance math does the rest: a running dot's ticks are blocked by the same seam, because a dot delivers its damage through the ordinary tagged path. Choosing the generic type over a bespoke one means an ordinary timed ward cooldown (`resistTags: ["fire"]`, factor 0.5) is now free content on the same case. ⚑ It does NOT protect the caster: `targetsSelf` is absent on purpose, so this is a skill you hold for somebody else, and the risk of being the one still exposed is the price of the grant. LEVEL BUYS BREADTH, NOT DEPTH - factor 0 cannot deepen, so `maxTargets` 1 +1/L is the only honest axis: L1 protects the nearest ally, L3 the nearest three. ⚑ No pip beyond the ordinary teal resist pip the buff store already lights on the target (D10: this plan does no visibility work; `applied_effects` is a full ubyte, backlog §39). Immunity reads in play as damage numbers that stop appearing. All values [PLACEHOLDER]: 150 ticks = 5 s at 30 tps, cooldown 900 = 30 s flat (level buys targets, not uptime - the Retribution rule), cost 0.04 +0.005/L, roughly twice Barrier's entry price for a strictly stronger grant. Obtainable in dev via the SKILL Sanctuary cheat; no unlock source yet (the FireShield precedent), real placement comes with the content pass.
